tools.name: futures_usds.listAllConvertPairs
tools.description:
List All Convert Pairs
Query for all convertible token pairs and the tokens’ respective upper/lower limits

Notes:
- User needs to supply either or both of the input parameter
- If not defined for both fromAsset and toAsset, only partial token pairs will be returned
- Asset BNFCR is only available to convert for MICA region users.

tools.description:
Send Quote Request (USER_DATA)
Request a quote for the requested token pairs

Notes:
- Either fromAmount or toAmount should be sent
- `quoteId` will be returned only if you have enough funds to convert

fromAmount.description: When specified, it is the amount you will be debited after the conversion

toAmount.description: When specified, it is the amount you will be credited after the conversion
